description: This file defines the LeaveEntitlement class, representing leave entitlement data within the OrangeHRM system, including properties like employee, leave type, date range, and related entitlements.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlement
classes.description: Entity class representing leave entitlement details, including employee, leave type, date range, and usage.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the leave entitlement.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the leave entitlement.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the employee associated with the entitlement.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the employee associated with the entitlement.

methods.name: getNoOfDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days of entitlement.

methods.name: setNoOfDays
methods.description: Sets the number of days of entitlement.

methods.name: getDaysUsed
methods.description: Returns the number of days used.

methods.name: setDaysUsed
methods.description: Sets the number of days used.

methods.name: getLeaveType
methods.description: Returns the leave type.

methods.name: setLeaveType
methods.description: Sets the leave type.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the entitlement period.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the entitlement period.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the entitlement period.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the entitlement period.

methods.name: getCreditedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the entitlement was credited.

methods.name: setCreditedDate
methods.description: Sets the credited date.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns the note associated with the entitlement.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets the note for the entitlement.

methods.name: getEntitlementType
methods.description: Returns the entitlement type.

methods.name: setEntitlementType
methods.description: Sets the entitlement type.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the entitlement is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Marks the entitlement as deleted or not.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Returns the user who created the entitlement.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the user who created the entitlement.
